exposure_history.A_B: Separate eligible author/learner contexts and same matched case plans/budgets; B-only authenticated source projection. No sequential continuing context is a clean code-access randomization.
exposure_history.feedback: All fold learners run sealed source automatically; no interactive view of all-fold train/calibration products can update source or transfer states between folds. A per-fold training group may be another fold held group only inside disjoint processes with no shared learned state or author feedback.
exposure_history.public_history: All old answers, final plots, admitted source text/examples, known notebook context and previously inspected data remain exposed development history. A clean private synthetic world requires new private seeds and held combinations.
exposure_history.strict_biological_or_sentence_transfer: Requires per-context proof that the held group inputs were never used in its source authoring, fitting, calibration, transform state or R work before P05. If previously exposed or unknown, mark exposed_development_descriptive/unknown_exposure; retain every I03/I04 output and denominator but refuse strict held-transfer qualification.

history_operator: O31 durably records every phase before/after effects, not merely final history reconstruction.
